text: ℤ[x] is a principal ideal domain.
explanation: The ideal (2, x) — polynomials with even constant term — is not principal: a single generator would have to divide both 2 and x, forcing it to be ±1, but (2,x) ≠ ℤ[x]. ℤ[x] is nevertheless a UFD by Gauss's theorem, showing UFD does not imply PID.
